scope: NOAA NGS Shoreline current Puerto Rico project-level source manifestations

adjudication.superseded_discovery_result: The prior 16-item result was a discovery-heuristic artifact caused by nearby-window associations with unrelated states. Source bytes are preserved; only the downstream project-denominator conclusion is superseded.
adjudication.project_discovery_rule: The project code and Puerto Rico jurisdiction evidence must occur in the same NOAA catalog link title.
adjudication.completion_report_rule: A report is PASS only when payload begins with PDF magic. The 15905-byte NOAA error payloads are not PDFs.
adjudication.geometry_archive_rule: A direct geometry archive is PASS only when the payload is a real ZIP with inventoried members. Guessed non-ZIP responses do not establish data absence.
adjudication.identity_rule: Project membership and spatial coverage metadata do not establish canonical insular-feature identity.
